title: Implementation of Section 51A of UAPA, 1967: Updates to UNSC's 1267/1989 ISIL (Da'esh) & Al-Qaida Sanctions List: Amendment of 1 Entry
description: RBI notification implementing Section 51A of the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act, with updates to the UN Security Council's sanctions list amendment. This notification relates to compliance and financial crime prevention frameworks that banks and NBFCs must follow.
